lane_role: inflation-expectation class (axis-2 PRIORITY), outcome-blind proposal 2 of 2
title: Expectation-realization gap state: market-implied expected inflation vs realized CPI trend as a slow USD purchasing-power regime
mechanism: Who is forced to act (or slow to react): reserve managers and long-horizon global allocators set strategic USD weights off purchasing-power trajectories reviewed on monthly-to-quarterly cycles; they are structurally slow, so when market-implied expected US inflation (the 10y breakeven) runs persistently far above the realized US inflation trend that anchor portfolios still assume, USD cash and USD-denominated assets are being repriced to erode faster than the realized trend their mandates price in, and the underweighting of USD arrives with a lag — producing drift of USD lower while the gap is wide, and the mirror-image drift higher when the market prices disinflation far below the still-sticky realized trend. Why the effect exists: this is relative-PPP logic operating at the expectation margin — the currency whose EXPECTED inflation exceeds its REALIZED trend is overpriced in purchasing-power terms and mean-reverts via slow portfolio underweighting, and neither input alone carries the signal (a high breakeven with correspondingly high realized trend is equilibrium, not dislocation; a high realized trend fully priced by breakevens is likewise no dislocation). Observable: GAP(t) = T10YIE as-of level minus CPIAUCSL as-of y/y (computed inside a single snapshot, rebase-invariant per AX2-C3), z-scored over a trailing year of the daily as-of stream. When it MUST fail: (i) if the DGS10 exposure-form control (nominal yield minus the same realized leg) reproduces the anchor, the state is a nominal-yield level position, not an expectation-realization state (F2-a); (ii) if the +7d sham-CPI-calendar neighbour reproduces or out-earns the anchor, the realized leg's genuine values/timing carry no or negative information and the rule is a slow breakeven-level position wearing a gap costume (F2-b, house clusters #10/#12 standard); (iii) if the gap regime is dominated by TIPS liquidity premia or a broad growth/risk USD trend, concentration/USD-drift diagnostics and PF gates fail; (iv) if the state moves too slowly to clear costs, the break-even-bps gate fails.

universe.position_convention: USD-short unit = +1 EURUSD, +1 GBPUSD, +1 AUDUSD, +1 NZDUSD, -1 USDJPY, -1 USDCAD, -1 USDCHF; equal risk unit per pair, no pair weighting, no cross-pair lead-lag structure
universe.jp_note: USDJPY trades on US-only conditioning like every pair; no JP CPI/FRED conditioning anywhere (AX2-C6)

conditioning.data_authority: p2_conditioning_clocks_v8.json r3 fields ONLY; verdicts PASS_PIT_EVIDENCED per p0_verdicts_final_v8.json; AX2-C1..C8 binding

fields.coverage_trim: full S0 (102 prints, first print 2017-01 first_available 2018-01-01)
fields.role: realized-inflation trend leg (y/y only, never level-level)
causal control: nominal-yield exposure form of the anchor gap

transforms.AX2-C1: every scoring-time pull is a single-date as-of snapshot (realtime_start = realtime_end = the decision's as-of date); current-vintage pulls forbidden in scored paths
transforms.AX2-C2_single_snapshot: for each decision, R(t) = 100 x (v_last / v_lag12 - 1) is computed INSIDE one as-of snapshot, where v_last is the CPIAUCSL obs with the latest effective_time whose available_time <= the decision instant and v_lag12 is the obs 12 reference-months earlier in the SAME snapshot; GAP(t) = T10YIE(t) - R(t); GAP_z(t) = GAP(t) z-scored over the trailing 252 obs of the as-of GAP stream (min 200 valid obs, else no-decision)
transforms.AX2-C3_rebase_safety: the only ratio used is y/y within one snapshot (rebase-invariant to first order; EZ/CH-HICP rebase-class evidence motivates the rule and the US leg ships the same rebase/revision event table from p2_rebase_revision_events_v8.json); level-level CPI conditioning FORBIDDEN and absent; splice-ratio adjustment FORBIDDEN and absent; CPI y/y value is carried forward between prints as a STATE (the rule runs every trading day, it is not a release-window rule)

conditioning.lags_policy: AX2-C4 per field: T10YIE consumed at the first 16:00-NY clock strictly after its available_time (median same-day); CPIAUCSL y/y enters at the first such clock strictly after the print's first_available (median lag 13 calendar days); the I/Q availability-lag mutation must shift the consumed decision exactly one period (a print arriving k periods late shifts the consumed decision exactly k periods); no other calendar enters any arm

decision_clock.spec: daily 16:00 America/New_York, DST-correct; FX 24/5 weekday convention; grid = S0 trading-day clocks (n=1907, 2018-04-04..2025-07-24); the book is evaluated at every clock (continuous state rule), with CPI print availability only governing when new realized values become consumable

warmup.derivation: z-window 252 obs of the GAP stream (which itself requires the first in-census CPI print available 2018-01-01) + rounding; no decisions before S0 clock 253 (~2019-02); warmup values computed but never traded

entry_exit_fills.entry: at the decision clock, when no position is open in a pair and GAP_z >= +0.75: open the USD-SHORT unit on ALL 7 pairs (expected inflation far above realized trend -> purchasing-power overpricing -> slow USD underweighting); when GAP_z <= -0.75: open the USD-LONG unit on ALL 7 pairs (disinflation priced below sticky realized trend -> USD purchasing-power underpricing); fill = that clock's daily close price
entry_exit_fills.exit: state exit with hysteresis: close when |GAP_z| < 0.25 at a decision clock; forced exit after max_hold_trading_days = 60 (risk bounding only, declared as such); fill at the exiting clock's close
entry_exit_fills.fills: same-clock market fill at daily close, no intrabar logic, no slippage beyond the cost ladder; position flips (state crossing sign while in-position) execute as close-and-reverse in the same clock
entry_exit_fills.dual_book: price-only book and financing-adjusted book carried per frozen invariant 6 (sign non-inversion)

costs.note: tier 2.0 PRIMARY for all gate evaluation (inherited V6/V7); low trade frequency concentrates the break-even-bps risk (frozen rule 5 floor 1.5 bps), which is declared as a primary expected failure surface

arms.arm_budget_note: the arm budget is exactly 3 and BOTH a DGS10 exposure-form control (AX2-C8, owner directive) and a +7d sham-calendar variant (house standard, clusters #10/#12, triggered because the realized leg's availability instants condition the state) are mandatory; the neighbour slot is therefore assigned to the mandatory sham-calendar variant

anchor.spec: GAP = T10YIE - CPIAUCSL_yy (true availability both legs); GAP_z over trailing 252 obs; entry |z| >= 0.75 (sign: z >= +0.75 SHORT USD, z <= -0.75 LONG USD), exit |z| < 0.25, max hold 60 trading days, all 7 pairs, continuous state rule at the daily clock
anchor.mechanism_bearing_components: BOTH the market-implied expectation level (T10YIE) AND the genuinely-timed realized-inflation trend (CPIAUCSL y/y as-of)

neighbour.type: mandatory +7d sham-calendar variant (house standard; falsification cluster instances #10 #12)
neighbour.spec: IDENTICAL rule in every field — same thresholds, window, hysteresis, holds, universe, direction, clock — except the CPIAUCSL availability stream used to build the realized leg is shifted +7 CALENDAR DAYS (sham calendar); the T10YIE stream stays true; AX2-C4 applies unchanged to the sham stream (a sham print shifts the consumed decision exactly one period after its sham availability)
neighbour.tests: whether the realized leg's GENUINE release timing/values carry the information (anchor materially different from sham) or the rule is indifferent to when realized data truly arrives (sham reproduces or out-earns anchor -> gap mechanism falsified, V5-class negative-information case if sham out-earns)

control.type: causal control (AX2-C8 MANDATORY nominal-yield exposure form)
control.spec: the anchor's gap geometry rebuilt with the expectation series swapped for the nominal yield: GAP_n = DGS10 - CPIAUCSL_yy (true availability both legs), identical z-window 252, entry 0.75 / exit 0.25, max hold 60, same direction convention, same universe and clock, same as-of semantics AX2-C1..C4
control.identifiability: differs from anchor ONLY in the mechanism-bearing component (T10YIE swapped for DGS10); the realized leg, timing, and trade geometry are byte-identical, so the control neither subsumes the anchor nor is a near-duplicate: it isolates exactly the claim that the EXPECTATION series (not any yield level) is the operative input
control.refutes: the convenient explanation 'this is a nominal-yield/carry-level position relabelled' (carry front door, measured rho 0.997-1.000 class)

falsification_rule.primary_numeric: F2-a NOMINAL RELABEL: if the DGS10 gap-form control's financing-adjusted expectancy per trade at tier 2.0 has the SAME SIGN as the anchor's AND |exp_control| >= 0.5 x |exp_anchor|, the family DIES as a nominal-yield exposure shadow (measured at D2 alongside the pooled ancestry-rho gate, never argued)
secondary_numeric: F2-b SHAM CALENDAR: if the +7d sham neighbour's expectancy has the anchor's sign AND |exp_sham| >= 0.5 x |exp_anchor|, OR the sham out-earns the anchor (same sign with |exp_sham| > |exp_anchor|, or opposite signs with sham > 0), the realized leg's genuine information is absent or negative -> family DIES (house clusters #10/#12 standard)
F2-c MECHANICAL: anchor financing-adjusted expectancy at tier 2.0 <= 0 -> family DIES (frozen rule 1)

F2-d INHERITED BASELINES: the anchor must additionally pass frozen rule_order 2..10 (pf >= 1.10, folds >= 2 positive, concentration <= 0.40, break-even bps <= 1.5, dual-book non-inversion, LOPO all subsets, stress tier 2.0 non-negative margin, USD-drift diagnostic, mechanism sanity); the family is promotable only if the anchor passes all AND neither F2-a nor F2-b fires
falsification_rule.nonvacuity: if anchor trades < 60 S0-wide (or any fold has 0 anchor trades), the cell is VOID as vacuous (BLOCKED_SELECTION-class), not evidence about the mechanism; unused slot never reassigned

expected_failure_interpretation.F2-a_fire: the purchasing-power gap is spanned by the nominal yield: whatever the anchor earns is a rates-level position; the expectation-realization gap class closes for this cycle
expected_failure_interpretation.F2-b_fire: the realized-inflation leg is dead weight (sham reproduces) or negative information (sham out-earns, V5-class); the 'gap' is a slow breakeven-level position and the stated mechanism is falsified; recorded, never rescued by retiming
expected_failure_interpretation.F2-c_or_gates_fire: either the PPP-at-the-expectation-margin drift does not exist on G10 spot at tradeable margins, or it exists but dies on the cost floor / stress tier / concentration — thin-margin class per P-2 recorded through margins_to_fail
expected_failure_interpretation.slow_state_warning: the most likely failure surface is the break-even-bps gate (few trades must carry 2 x 1.5 bps x 2.0 tier = 6 bps round-trip): a thin-margin rejection here is a COST verdict, not a mechanism-absence verdict, and is recorded as such

fold_structure.gate_inherited: positive_populated_folds >= 2 of 3 (frozen rule 3); fold boundaries fixed at D1, never moved after PnL is visible

decision_count_sanity.trigger_rate_assumption: a 252-obs z of a slowly-moving daily state spends ~25-45% of clocks outside the |z|<0.25 hysteresis band; 60-day max hold bounds episode length at 27+ forced episodes minimum; expected true episodes 25-45 across S0, x 7 pairs
decision_count_sanity.verdict: non-vacuous: >= ~20 anchor trades per fold expected on 7 pairs, enough for 3 populated folds; the 60-trade floor guards the vacuous tail

novelty_attestation.not_entered_classes: no session momentum/fade, no range structures, no policy-rate input (DGS10 appears ONLY as the mandatory exposure-form control, never as an anchor input), no vol gating, no commodity-bloc risk-off basket, no release-window avoidance (the book runs continuously, entries are never scheduled around releases and no post-release session logic exists), no reaction-direction conditioning on release signs (no release-day spot reaction sign enters any rule — the CPI leg enters as a y/y VALUE state, never as a sign/reaction), no EURUSD lead-lag diffusion, no USD-PC1 gated reversal (the gate is a US expectation-realization state, not a cross-pair return factor; direction is PPP-frozen, not spot-reversal), no cross-economy real-yield differential (no foreign market real-yield series exists or is used; the foreign realized-CPI legs of the census are NOT used here — the construct is US-internal, expectation-minus-realized, not a cross-economy differential)
novelty_attestation.sham_calendar_discharge: the CPI availability instants condition the state, so the mandatory +7d sham-calendar variant is included as the neighbour arm per house standard (clusters #10/#12)
novelty_attestation.ancestry_rho_exposure: anchor conditioning exposures (slow T10YIE-minus-CPIy/y state, daily 16:00-NY grid) are a priori low-rho vs carry-region, session, release-window and reaction-direction ancestry exposures (different input series, different clock geometry, no event windows); measured at D2 pre-selection, bar |rho| <= 0.20, never argued
